title: Scientists Make Easter Island Statue Walk | National Geographic
summary: A one-minute National Geographic clip of researchers Terry Hunt and Carl Lipo testing a theory that Easter Islanders used ropes to rock the moai statues upright to walk them to their platforms.
why: Cited as evidence of how ancient people could move huge stones with only ropes and simple methods.

quote.text: This is how some researchers think easter island heads were moved around
